newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Inco cut to neutral.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Inco cut to neutral.

text.p: -- Lehman Brothers said analyst Richard Aldrich reduced the rating on Inco Ltd to neutral from outperform.

-- cited reduction in spot nickel price forecast to $3.55 per pound from $4.25 for 1997; increase in break-even nickel price assumption to $2.80 per pound through 1997, assuming average copper price of $0.95 per pound; and reduction in share repurchase assumptions.
-- shares fell 1/4 to 32-3/8 on the New York Stock Exchange at midmorning.
